aerodynamic_torque_only.interpretation_read: Direct spar-pair rotation is the rigid-section AVL Ainc stress-test. Quarter-chord projection checks the aerodynamic reference consistency. The bounded physical projection spreads the measured spar-pair vertical differential over at least 75% of local AVL chord; if it still exceeds the bound, the blocker is not just a narrow spar-reference artifact.
